titel: Object- and Task-Aware Active Perception for Safe Navigation of Mobile Manipulators in Semi-Static Environments
text: Mobile manipulators must navigate safely in cluttered, partially unknown environments across logistics, manufacturing, and service applications. Semi-static changes between robot visits can lead to outdated scene knowledge and increased collision risk. We propose an active perception framework that enables a high degree-of-freedom (DoF) mobile manipulator to inspect uncertain or safety-critical regions with its hand camera during navigation. titel: Payload generalization on feedforward control actions for trajectory tracking in robots with rigid and elastic joints
text: Industries employ robots for repetitive tasks due to their high precision and performance, typically achieved through feedforward control actions based on an accurate robot description. titel: Physical AI for Intralogistics: Benchmarking the NVIDIA Sim-to-Real Ecosystem for Cosmos-Enhanced COMPASS Navigation on Industrial Mobile Robots
text: Classical robot navigation stacks are reliable but often require re-engineering for each new robot type and site. titel: JARVIS: From Visual Manuals to Autonomous Robotic Assembly

We introduce JARVIS, a method-agnostic benchmark for autonomous visual-manual-guided execution without additional language instructions. berryroad: Spielzeugdomäne ohne Bezug zu industrieller Montage. Keine Relevanz für Lastenhefte oder Planung.

titel: Physical AI: Concepts, Techniques, and Challenges
text: In recent years, physical artificial intelligence (physical AI) has experienced rapid development, capturing significant attention in academia and industry. berryroad: Nützlich als Begriffsgrundlage, um Anbieter-Aussagen zu Physical AI einzuordnen. Kein direkter Bezug zu einem Angebot.

text: Fine industrial robotic manipulation requires 6D pose, scale, and an operation-ready 3D model. text: General purpose multimodal language models (LMs) are increasingly capable of directly controlling robotic arms (e.g., by commanding end effector poses) to manipulate their environment. berryroad: Zeigt den Stand allgemeiner Modelle als Robotersteuerung. Für industrielle Zellen mit Sicherheitsanforderungen derzeit ohne Nutzen, aber als Signal zur Einordnung von Hype wichtig.

titel: How exposed is work to robotics? Occupational, industry, and geographic measures
text: Exposure indices that map technical capabilities onto occupational abilities have become a standard tool for anticipating how AI may reshape work, but existing measures either cover software AI or proxy robotics through patents and installation data that reflect the industrial robots of past decades. berryroad: Liefert Hintergrund zu Automatisierungsdruck nach Branche, etwa für Argumente zum Fachkräftemangel. Keine unmittelbare Angebotsrelevanz.

titel: Multimodal Interaction Estimation for Contact-Aware Adaptive Impedance Control
text: With advancements in learning-based policies, robots are increasingly being deployed in human-centric environments, such as manufacturing floors and homes, where safe and precise operation requires compensating for unknown loads while remaining compliant during human interactions. titel: Blind Precise Assembly: Proprioceptive Sim-to-Real Peg-in-Hole for Diverse Parts
text: Every robot already carries high-resolution contact sensors: its own joints. Legged robots and humanoids exploit them to walk, run, and track whole-body motions without vision, but there the contacts are large and forceful. Is joint sensing also enough for precise, contact-rich assembly, where the robot must find a millimeter-scale opening, mesh gear teeth, or catch a thread through light contact? berryroad: Montage mit Millimetertoleranzen ist für Fertigung relevant. Die Sensorik-Einsparung klingt interessant, ist aber bislang nur Forschung ohne Industrietest.

titel: Embodiment-Aware Planning for Heterogeneous Bimanual Manipulation
text: Many manipulation tasks that are effortless for dexterous human hands remain challenging for robotic systems equipped with simple, task-specialized grippers. Industrial platforms commonly rely on end-effectors such as suction cups or parallel-jaw grippers, yet no single mode can reliably satisfy the diverse constraints encountered across different phases of complex manipulation tasks, including pickup, reorientation, insertion, and constrained placement. berryroad: Greiferkonzepte mit einfacher Hardware sind im Mittelstand verbreitet. Der Ansatz ist aber noch Forschung und hat keinen direkten Bezug zu Angeboten.

titel: FCTS: Failure-Guided Curriculum Tree Search Over Generated Terrain for Legged Parkour
text: Quadruped parkour policies handle canonical obstacles well, but their training curricula often miss the irregular, compound geometry of industrial and disaster-response sites, where agile locomotion matters most. Such environments pose a hard generalization problem: even training directly on reconstructed geometry from the target site does not reliably yield policies that traverse it. titel: De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins

The UK Space Agency-supported ISPARK project is developing a physics-grounded digital twin for structured process de-risking. berryroad: Kein Bezug zu Fertigungsautomatisierung oder den Zielkunden. Nicht verwertbar für Angebot oder Akquise.

titel: Location-Based Safety Management with Wearable Seamless Indoor-Outdoor Positioning
text: Reliable worker localization is essential for real-time industrial safety management, but seamless outdoor-indoor positioning remains challenging. GNSS performs well outdoors yet degrades near buildings and fails indoors, while many indoor systems require costly infrastructure or extensive calibration. text: Rigid closed chains can admit indeterminate internal reactions even when their motion is fully specified. berryroad: Mechanik-Grundlagenarbeit ohne Bezug zur Fertigungsplanung im Mittelstand. Keine Relevanz für das Tagesgeschäft.

titel: A Black-Box Positioning Solution for Effortless Integration in Wearable Navigation
text: Accurate localization is critical for a wide range of applications, including navigation, augmented reality, safety management, and healthcare. However, achieving accurate positioning remains challenging, especially in GPS-degraded environments. Pedestrian Dead Reckoning (PDR), which estimates position based on inertial sensor data, offers a promising alternative but typically demands substantial effort in algorithm design and system integration. titel: Human Demonstrations as Post-Training Data for Any Robot Body: Retargeting the Object, Not the Hand

A human demonstration recorded on a simple and scalable device such as a mobile phone can serve as post-training data for a robot whose body differs in structure and capability from the human who recorded it. titel: TacClaw-Infinity: A Large-Scale Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Dataset for Dexterous Manipulation

titel: Design and Characterization of a Unified Continuum Robot Actuation Platform
text: Continuum robots enable dexterous access to confined spaces in applications such as minimally invasive surgery and industrial inspection. However, their actuation systems are often custom-designed for specific robot architectures and tasks, limiting reuse across publications, institutions, and applications. titel: ForceBench: Benchmarking Force Integration for Robotic Manipulation
text: Force feedback provides vision-language-action (VLA) policies with physical observations that can guide action selection and execution. titel: Large Language Models Meet Bayesian Optimization: Towards Self-evolving Wireless Digital Twins

titel: TwinStore: A Synthetic Consumer Platform Using Vision--Language Models
text: We present TwinStore, a source-available synthetic consumer platform for physical retail built on vision--language models. TwinStore turns a store into a digital twin---from 82 ready-made formats, a floor-plan image or phone photos of its shelves---and fills it with synthetic shoppers who plan a trip, walk the aisles and decide what to buy by looking at rendered shelves with packs, price tags and promotion signs. titel: CityPaint: A Free Lunch from 2D Diffusion for City-Scale 3D Texturing

berryroad: Keine Relevanz für die Fertigungsautomatisierung.

titel: Epi: Towards a Persistent, Self-Improving Agent for Autonomous Research

titel: Concordance Plausibility Check for Intervention-Conditioned Human Digital Twins
text: Intervention-conditioned human digital twins predict treatment alternatives that cannot be observed in the same patient. Ordinary predictive accuracy therefore cannot establish counterfactual credibility. We propose the Concordance Plausibility Check (CPC), a claim-centered framework combining real-world evidence, qualified simulation and clinical knowledge. CPC matches evidence to the causal claim, audits contradictions and shared dependencies, and reports Pass, Fail or reason-coded Indeterminate.
